jei.betterthanwolves.info.kiln.1: Kiln: a block of bricks directly above stoked fire turns into a kiln. A block resting on top of the kiln is fired once at least 3 of its other 5 faces (the top and the four sides) touch bricks or kiln blocks.
jei.betterthanwolves.info.kiln.2: Firing takes 16 steps of 2 to 8 seconds each: the more of the 8 blocks around the stoked fire are also stoked fire, the faster it goes. Unfired pottery and bricks take 4x as long; ores, ore chunks, logs and end stone 8x.
jei.betterthanwolves.info.kiln.3: Unfired pottery becomes a crucible, planter, vase, urn or mould; unfired bricks become bricks or nether bricks; bread dough, uncooked cake, pumpkin pie and cookies are baked (8 cookies). Iron and gold ore and ore chunks give nuggets, ore-chunk storage blocks give ingots, logs give charcoal, end stone gives ender slag and white cobblestone.
jei.betterthanwolves.info.saw.1: Saw: runs while it receives mechanical power and cuts the block in front of its blade about once a second. Living things in front of a running blade are hurt.
jei.betterthanwolves.info.saw.2: Logs give 4 planks, 2 sawdust and bark; planks give 2 siding; siding gives 2 moulding; moulding gives 2 corners; corners give 2 gears; wooden stairs give a siding and a moulding; wooden slabs give 2 mouldings; fences give 2 corners. Stone, metal and other solid non-wood blocks break the saw.
jei.betterthanwolves.info.turntable.1: Turntable: turns while it receives mechanical power, rotating up to 2 blocks stacked on it. Right-click to change the speed (a turn every 0.5, 1, 2 or 4 seconds); a redstone signal reverses the direction.
jei.betterthanwolves.info.turntable.2: Every 8 turns a block of unfired clay is shaped into an unfired crucible, then a planter, a vase, an urn, and finally used up, throwing off clay at each step. Other unfired shapes (moulds, bricks, dough) are turned back into their ingredient.
jei.betterthanwolves.info.hopper.1: Hopper filters: the block or item in the filter slot decides what may pass. A soul sand filter only lets ground netherrack, soul dust and glowstone dust through and transforms them: ground netherrack into hellfire dust, soul dust into sawdust, glowstone dust into brimstone, releasing one soul per item.
jei.betterthanwolves.info.hopper.2: A running hopper keeps its souls only while it sits on an urn: at 8 souls the urn becomes a soul urn. With no urn below, the souls escape. If 8 souls build up in a stopped hopper, it breaks.
jei.betterthanwolves.info.hopper.3: A wicker filter only lets fine items through and sifts gravel into sand (kept in the hopper) and flint (left on top).
jei.betterthanwolves.info.hibachi.1: Hibachi: lights, and sets fire above itself, while it receives a redstone signal; it goes out when the signal stops.
jei.betterthanwolves.info.hibachi.2: Bellows blowing on fire that sits on a lit hibachi turn it into stoked fire. Stoked fire only lasts a few seconds unless the bellows keep blowing, then falls back to normal fire. It turns a block of bricks above it into a kiln and makes cauldrons and crucibles use their stoked recipes.
jei.betterthanwolves.info.cooking_vessel: Cauldron and crucible: cook while upright over fire. Normal fire or a medium/large campfire uses the normal recipes; stoked fire uses the stoked recipes. Each matching fire among the 8 blocks around the one beneath speeds it up: a batch takes about 43 seconds over a single fire and 7.5 seconds when fully surrounded.
A vessel tilted by mechanical power does not cook. Hellfire dust, gunpowder, TNT or blasting oil inside a vessel over stoked fire will explode.
jei.betterthanwolves.info.campfire.1: Campfire: right-click it with a pointy stick to add a spit, then place one food item on the spit. It cooks after 4 minutes over a medium fire; a small fire does not cook.
jei.betterthanwolves.info.campfire.2: A blazing fire burns whatever is on the spit into burned meat after 2 minutes. A damaged spit breaks when food is placed on it.
